text:
Jordan Kim: quick q on retargeting channel setup for the lifecycle sprint — we’re getting LinkedIn + Google stood up this week. Before I ping the agency/partners, can we confirm:
1) audience rules (who’s IN/OUT)
2) tracking constraints (UTMs, gclid, LI click IDs)
3) any “no-go” wording/targeting constraints from privacy/compliance

Ben Carter: yep. goal is: non-activated signups + recently lapsed. targeting should stay dev-first (benchmarks/proof points), no creepy personalization.

Tyler Benson: adding specifics from ops side:
- Audiences we can support in v1:
  A) Non-activated: signed up, created API key OR not, but *no* `first_request_success` within 72h of signup.
  B) Lapsed: had at least 1 success historically but *no* `request_success` in last 14 days.
- Exclusions:
  - anyone with `billing_added` OR “paid” account status
  - anyone marked “sales_assist” in HubSpot (we don’t want ads fighting outbound)
  - suppression list: unsubscribes + do-not-contact (global)

Soojin Lee: +1 on exclusions. also please exclude “VPC/on-prem interest” flagged leads (QuartzFin-type) unless creative is explicitly Private-safe (no strong cost/latency claims w/o substantiation, and no “get started in 2 minutes” language).

Jordan Kim: ok. do we need separate audiences per channel? LinkedIn has minimum match size, right?

Tyler Benson: yep. LinkedIn Matched Audiences:
- Website retargeting will work fastest (Insight Tag on landing page). Minimum is usually easier than contact list match.
- Contact list (hashed emails) requires min size; also takes time to process.
Google:
- can do RLSA / display remarketing based on site visits + (optional) Customer Match.

Camila Reyes: can we keep it simple for week 1? website retargeting only, then add Customer Match week 2 once list sizes are safe.

Ben Carter: agreed. week 1 = warm retargeting (site visitors + landing page hits) + “signed up but didn’t activate” if we can do that without shipping PII.

Tyler Benson: re: “signed up but didn’t activate” — for ad platforms, we can’t send user-level identifiers directly. options:
1) If we have consent + hashed email export via HubSpot lists → LinkedIn/Google Customer Match (needs privacy check + min list sizes).
2) Keep it on-site: drive from email + organic → landing page, then retarget those visitors.

Jordan Kim: so for week 1, it’s basically: landing page visitors retargeted on LI + Google. how do we map conversions back to product activation?

Tyler Benson: UTMs + event stitching.
- All ads MUST use UTMs (no exceptions). Proposed convention:
  - `utm_source=linkedin` or `utm_source=google`
  - `utm_medium=paid_social` (LI) / `utm_medium=paid_search` or `display` (Google)
  - `utm_campaign=lifecycle_sprint_wk1_activation` (or similar)
  - `utm_content=` for creative variant id
  - `utm_term=` for Google keyword/adgroup when relevant
- Constraints:
  - No PII in query params. don’t put email/company name in URL.
  - Keep UTM keys lowercase; consistent ordering helps debugging.
- Attribution:
  - Landing page captures UTMs client-side.
  - When user signs in / creates account, we persist UTM fields onto the user/project (server-side) and attach to events like `api_key_created`, `first_request_success`, etc.

Ethan Wallace: for benchmark proof points in ads, please link to a stable canonical URL (blog/docs) so we’re not sending to a draft doc. I can provide the “benchmarks” page once Soojin signs off.

Soojin Lee: + please avoid absolute claims like “fastest” unless we cite. preferred phrasing: “low latency”, “predictable throughput”, “production-grade inference”, “see benchmark methodology”.

Jordan Kim: got it. any gotchas with click IDs? gclid / msclkid / LinkedIn click id?

Tyler Benson: we can capture them but we need to be careful:
- Google `gclid`: ok to capture as a pseudonymous identifier. store with standard retention rules. don’t surface in UI.
- LinkedIn has `li_fat_id` cookie + Insight Tag handles a lot. We don’t need to append click IDs manually.
- Key: don’t pass those IDs into our own product analytics events as raw fields unless needed. If we do, keep them in a restricted table/access (privacy review flagged this last time).

Partner Ops Bot: Tyler Benson added a reminder: "Run final UTM + tracking setup by Security/Compliance checklist before launch." (deliverability-and-suppression-plan)

Ben Carter: also for measurement, we care about:
- activation within 24h/72h after click
- time-to-first-success
- D7 retention
so the landing page should push to quickstart + troubleshooting, not just “book a demo”.

Camila Reyes: + guardrail: if ad volume drives confusion tickets, we pause. Jordan can you include Support contact link in the landing page footer (not in ads)?

Jordan Kim: yes. last thing: audience windows. what’s our membership duration? 14 days? 30?

Tyler Benson: proposal:
- Non-activated: 7-day membership (keep it tight, reduce wasted spend)
- Lapsed: 30-day membership (but exclude if they re-activate)
- Frequency cap: LI 3 impressions/day, Google 5/day (tunable)

Soojin Lee: please ensure exclusions update quickly (reactivation should remove them). otherwise we’ll look sloppy (“welcome back” ads to active users).

Tyler Benson: yep. for website audiences it’s slower (cookie-based), but for Customer Match lists we can refresh daily. For week 1 with site retargeting, best we can do is keep creative generic (no “you didn’t activate” copy). Keep it “ship your first request fast” style.

Ben Carter: perfect. Jordan, can you send a short summary to #marketing once you’ve got channel settings drafted? include UTM template + audience definitions.

Jordan Kim: will do. I’ll draft:
- LinkedIn: website retargeting (landing page + docs quickstart page if tag is there)
- Google: display remarketing + (optional) RLSA if we have search set up
- UTMs per Tyler’s convention
and I’ll hold Customer Match until we confirm list size + privacy ok.

Tyler Benson: :thumbsup: I’ll drop the UTM naming sheet link + example URLs in-thread.
Example:
`https://redwoodinference.com/quickstart?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=paid_social&utm_campaign=lifecycle_sprint_wk1_activation&utm_content=ad_a_latency`

Ethan Wallace: when you have draft creative, tag me + Soojin. I’ll attach benchmark substantiation links.

Camila Reyes: thanks all. keep it tight and measurable.
